products.name: Hair Serum
products.subtitle: Folilock PRO Hair Serum is an intense formula designed to reverse hair ageing and restore hair vitality. Powered by potent active ingredients including MelanoGray™, Arcolys®, Biotin, Aquaxyl®, and Rosemary, this serum works effectively to combat premature greying, strengthen roots, and deeply hydrate the scalp and hair. Free from parabens and alcohol, it nourishes and revitalizes strands without leaving any greasy residue.
